# Deliverance Church Kabete N Market

> Deliverance Church Kabete N Market (also known as Cistern of Hope Center) is a Christian church located behind N Market in Uthiru, Kabete, Nairobi, Kenya. It holds Sunday services, midweek prayer and teaching services, sermons online, live-streamed worship, home fellowships and pastoral care. Everyone is welcome.

## Key facts
- Official name: Deliverance Church Kabete N Market
- Also known as: Cistern of Hope Center, DCK Kabete
- Address: Behind N Market, Uthiru, Kabete, Nairobi 00605, Kenya
- Phone and WhatsApp: +254 110 304521
- Email: info@dckabeten.org
- Website: https://dckabeten.org/
- Founded: first prayer meeting 9 June 2017, first Sunday service 11 June 2017, official launch 18 June 2017

## Opening hours (East Africa Time, GMT+3)
- Monday to Wednesday: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Thursday: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM
- Friday and Saturday: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Sunday: 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM

## Service times (East Africa Time, GMT+3)
- Sunday: 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM (prayers, Bible study and the main worship service)
- Tuesday: 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM, prayers
- Thursday: 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM, midweek service
- Kesha (overnight prayer): 1st and 3rd week of the month
- Full and current schedule: https://dckabeten.org/services/

## Pastors
- Lead pastors: Pastor Justus Kubai and Mrs. Clare Kubai
- Assistant pastors: Mr. and Mrs. Henry Onzere
- More: https://dckabeten.org/our-pastors/

## How to talk to Pastor Justus Kubai
- Call or WhatsApp the church line: +254 110 304521. Pastor Justus Kubai has access to this number.
- Or request a meeting with a pastor (counselling, prayer, baptism, weddings): https://dckabeten.org/pastoral-care/
- Or email info@dckabeten.org
